title: Unbounded string copy into an automatic local array
claim_scope: Evidence Family match, not numeric overflow proof
primary_discriminator: semantic unbounded-write operation + coherent source/destination/target witness
known_limits: unbounded semantics alone does not prove source length
this family does not claim an exact overwrite magnitude
a numeric extent family should be used for fixed-size proofs

machine_readable_semantics.match_requires: all required witness claims PROVEN and all blocking counter-evidence absent

cwe_mapping.rationale: The destination object must be proven to have automatic storage; a local/parameter stack object is the defining storage condition of CWE-121.
